_comment: The LEGO shot. Same hammering beat as shot_steel.json, re-imagined in bricks — a style change is a prompt change, and this one also carries the LoRA's trigger phrase, without which the adapter does nothing at all.
name: steel-hammering-lego
prompt: l3g0_5ty13 Lego animation style, a Lego minifigure blacksmith with a brown beard, a leather apron and gloved hands stands at a Lego anvil inside a Lego castle forge built from grey and brown bricks. Low camera angle looking slightly up so the anvil and the smith fill the frame. He raises a Lego hammer high and brings it down hard onto a glowing translucent orange Lego sword blade lying across the anvil. On every impact a burst of small translucent orange and yellow Lego stud pieces flies outward like sparks and tumbles down under gravity, scattering across the baseplate; the struck blade flashes brighter and dims again; the hammer bounces back up and comes down for the next blow in a steady rhythm. A Lego furnace glows behind with translucent orange flame pieces and a wisp of grey brick smoke. Glossy plastic bricks with visible studs and seams and moulding marks, stop-motion Lego animation, warm light from the furnace, deep shadow, shallow depth of field. The camera does not move.
